name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Soundproof
abilities.desc: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.

abilities.name: Filter
abilities.desc: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

abilities.name: Psychic Surge
abilities.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.

flavor: Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.

forms.name: Galarian Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.desc: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.

abilities.name: Screen Cleaner
abilities.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

forms.flavor: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

forms.name: Mega Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Psychic Wall
abilities.desc: When entering battle, the user creates a invisible wall, making moves that make direct contact miss the user.

forms.flavor: A description for this Pokémon has not been written yet.
